versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- Launches behavior-based personalization for first-time visitors.
- Maps browse path to preference segments and matches targeted first-order incentives.
- Specifies popup timing, prioritizing exit intent with timed or event-based backups.
- Includes clear guidance on output tables (path→segment, segment→offer, trigger spec).
- Designed for onboarding and first-purchase conversion—not for loyalty win-back or returning customers.

- Initial release of the new-visitor-cold-start skill.
- Converts first-time store visitors using behavior-based personalization and matched first-order incentives.
- Includes workflow to monitor browsing path, classify user preference segment, match targeted offer, and set popup/modal trigger timing (with exit intent as primary).
- Provides required context gathering steps and mandatory output tables for path-to-segment, segment-to-offer, and trigger specs.
- Not intended for repeat-customer or post-purchase-only flows.
